profile.name: 实验数据加载与绘图工具
profile.description: 用于从 HDF5 实验数据文件中读取多维测量数据、进行筛选、平均和维度整理，并将结果显示到对应视图中的实验数据后处理软件组件。常用于实验结果浏览、快速检查和基础可视化。
profile.description_en: A post-processing software component that loads multidimensional measurement data from HDF5 experimental data files, applies filtering, averaging, and dimension handling, and displays the results in appropriate viewers. It is used for browsing, quick inspection, and basic visualization of experimental results.

registry.name: Loader Plotter
registry.description: Loader Plotter是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括加载、数据保存、设备连接、运动控制。支持Signal, Slot, average axis等操作。
